news.headline: FDA accepts AMT-130 BLA with Priority Review; PDUFA date May 1, 2027, AdCom tentatively planned
news.summary: The FDA accepted the accelerated-approval BLA for ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130), filed on the 36-month data, and granted Priority Review with a May 1, 2027 target action date. The agency said it is tentatively planning an advisory committee meeting with no date set yet, and uniQure plans to begin US screening for the roughly 200-patient confirmatory study by the end of 2026.

news.headline: uniQure sets Q3 2026 results for November 4
news.summary: uniQure announced it will report third-quarter 2026 financial results and give a company update on November 4, 2026, earlier than the November 9-10 window third-party calendars had projected. The timing falls just after the FDA's 60-day filing review on the AMT-130 BLA ends around November 1, so the call is likely to carry the acceptance and priority-review outcome.

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase lifts its passive uniQure stake to about 8.5% (5.95M shares)
news.summary: An amended Schedule 13G/A shows JPMorgan Chase holding 5,951,794 uniQure shares (about 8.5%) through several subsidiaries, up from 4.87M shares (7.0%) reported in July. The increase through the post-readout selloff signals that at least one large holder added rather than exited after the four-year AMT-130 data.

news.headline: UBS assumes coverage at Buy and lifts its price target to $48 from $27
news.summary: UBS took over coverage with a Buy rating and a $48 target, arguing the filing rests on the stronger 36-month data that the FDA had agreed to as the basis for accelerated approval. Together with other bullish notes it helped the stock rebound from the post-readout lows, with shares up about 7% to $22.52 on October 15.

news.headline: Barclays downgrades uniQure to Equal-Weight and cuts its target to $28 from $60
news.summary: Barclays analyst Eliana Merle downgraded the stock, citing greater uncertainty around AMT-130 after the four-year data, sending shares down about 5.5%. Goldman Sachs (Neutral, $46 to $31) and RBC ($65 to $48) also cut their targets after the readout.

news.headline: Four-year AMT-130 data: 44% cUHDRS slowing at high dose, not statistically significant
news.summary: In 12 high-dose patients at 48 months, AMT-130 slowed cUHDRS decline by 44% versus the Enroll-HD external control (p=0.144), while Total Functional Capacity held up at 61% slowing (p=0.008). uniQure stressed that the BLA rests on the 36-month analysis, which it restated as 80% cUHDRS slowing (p=0.005) and 67% TFC slowing; critics pointed to missing data and possible survivor bias in the control group. Shares fell about 39% that day, from a $39.11 close to well below the $45.50 price of the June equity raise.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 results and regulatory update
catalysts.detail: uniQure confirmed it will report Q3 2026 results and give a company update on November 4, 2026, before the market opens. The FDA acceptance is already public, so the focus shifts to the advisory-committee timing, the UK MAA, the start of confirmatory-trial screening, AMT-260 second-cohort enrollment and cash burn against the $810.3M June 30 cash position.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory trial screening start
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to begin US screening by the end of 2026 for the roughly 200-patient study, randomized 2:1 to AMT-130 versus standard of care, with Total Functional Capacity at 36 months as the primary endpoint. Management expects the study to be well underway by the time of a potential approval; TFC was the endpoint that stayed statistically significant at four years.

catalysts.label: Additional international regulatory pathways
catalysts.detail: uniQure has said it is pursuing registration routes for AMT-130 beyond the US and UK, including EU options, with an update guided for the second half of 2026. No EMA or other-jurisdiction filing plan has been disclosed yet.

catalysts.label: FDA advisory committee meeting for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: In the November 2 acceptance letter the FDA said it is tentatively planning to discuss the BLA at an advisory committee; the date has not been set and uniQure will announce it once finalized. Given the small, externally controlled dataset and the weaker four-year cUHDRS result, the panel vote is likely the key pre-PDUFA event.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 higher-dose epilepsy data and AMT-191 Fabry update
catalysts.detail: Updated Phase I/IIa data in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy, including the second, higher-dose cohort, are planned for H1 2027 after first-cohort data in June 2026 showed 79-100% disabling-seizure reductions in three of six patients. A Fabry (AMT-191) update is guided to the same window, but dosing there is paused pending evaluation of liver enzyme elevations in two mid-dose patients. With AMT-130 sentiment damaged, these pipeline readouts carry more weight.

catalysts.label: ICER evidence report and CEPAC verdict
catalysts.detail: ICER's draft evidence report on AMT-130 is due in January 2027, followed by a Midwest CEPAC public meeting and vote in March 2027 and a final report in April 2027, just before the May 1 PDUFA date. The four-year durability data will feed directly into its cost-effectiveness modeling for a one-time gene therapy.

catalysts.label: FDA PDUFA date for AMT-130 (accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: The FDA accepted the BLA with Priority Review and set a May 1, 2027 target action date. Approval would make AMT-130 the first disease-modifying therapy for Huntington's disease, but acceptance does not guarantee approval and an advisory committee is tentatively planned beforehand.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA marketing authorisation decision
catalysts.detail: The MAA filed with the MHRA on September 2 runs on its own clock, independent of the FDA, offering a second potential approval route. uniQure has not disclosed an expected MHRA decision timeline.

pulse: As of November 3, 2026, QURE's main regulatory overhang has cleared: the FDA accepted the AMT-130 BLA on the 36-month data, granted Priority Review and set a May 1, 2027 PDUFA date, though it also tentatively plans an advisory committee, a public test after the non-significant four-year cUHDRS result. Shares came into the news near $24.83 (October 30 close), far below pre-readout levels, and trading on November 2 swung between an initial jump and intraday weakness as investors weighed the AdCom risk. Next up are the Q3 results and company update on November 4, the AdCom date, and the start of confirmatory-trial screening by year-end.
